# Slider
Slider - pick a number, or a range between two numbers, by moving a thumb along a track. Figma sets: Slider (550:241: Orientation horizontal | vertical x Range false | true x State default | disabled, 8 variants, plus Label, Value, Helper, Leading and Trailing switches and text), internal .Slider / Bar (550:96: Orientation x Range x Disabled) and .Slider / Toggle (550:15: the thumb, State default | hover | focus-visible). Track 4 (spacing/1) background-muted, radius/full; fill and thumb border primary; thumb 16 (spacing/4) with a 2 border, surface fill and shadow/sm; hover halo 4 of primary-subtle; focus-visible a 2 focus-ring ring with a 2 gap; disabled opacity 0.5. Hit area 44 (touch/min) in code. value, min, max and step are code props, not variants; the bar is drawn at 50 and at 30 to 70.

When to use: a value on a continuous scale where position matters more than the exact number (volume, brightness), or a range between a minimum and a maximum (Range=true).
When not to use: an exact number typed in (use Input), a few named options (use Radio Group or a select), progress the user does not control (use Progress).

Do: name every thumb and show the current value as text; use vertical only in a tall, narrow layout.

Accessibility: each thumb is role=slider with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, optional aria-valuetext and aria-orientation; arrows step, PageUp and PageDown take 10 steps, Home and End jump to the ends; range thumbs are named Minimum and Maximum and cannot cross; RTL mirrors the horizontal track.
